correctness.rationale: The additive-channel Fourier calculation gives exact rectangular factor-mask and rank-ball maximal correlations. A direct kernel-vector count gives the rectangular converse and specializes to the published square formula. Tensor-product singular values give the two-upload law, and the entropy argument gives the rectangular differential-privacy obstruction. Exhaustive F_2 checks confirm representative formulas.

originality.rationale: Qualified to the best of our knowledge. The 16 September 2026 motivating preprint formulates the protocol for rectangular matrices but states its strongest privacy theorems for square inputs. Targeted external and SCOPE searches found no prior rectangular theorem package. Classical bilinear-forms association schemes may contain equivalent character-sum identities, and the very recent source creates a material near-simultaneous-discovery risk.

value.rationale: The result removes a square-only restriction from the privacy analysis of an intrinsically rectangular multiplication protocol, gives exact maximal-correlation values and an aspect-ratio-aware converse, identifies the weaker of two mask ranks as the exact factor-mask bottleneck, and extends the rank-bounded differential-privacy obstruction.
